query:
UPDATE deals SET status = ?2,
                 confirmed_at = CASE WHEN ?2 = 'confirmed' THEN ?3
                                     ELSE confirmed_at END,
                 rejected_at = CASE WHEN ?2 = 'rejected' THEN ?3
                                    ELSE rejected_at END,
                 expired_at = CASE WHEN ?2 = 'expired' THEN ?3
                                   ELSE expired_at END
             WHERE id = ?1
